"''You and me.''"
"''If you'd like.|Kier Domadi and Leia Organa|}} The '''Glarus Lagoons''', or '''Glarus lagoon''', were located on the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. In [[3 BBY]], [[Apprentice Legislator]] [[Kier Domadi]] suggested visiting the Glarus Lagoons to his peer, the [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. The lagoons had been destroyed at some point by [[1 BBY]] when Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan|annihilated]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. ==Description== The Glarus Lagoons, also referred to as the Glarus lagoon,{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} were located in a [[Temperature|balmy]] region of the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. The lagoons featured several [[Water|swimming]] areas and were home to [[Species|sea life]]. The Glarus Lagoons had at least one sandy [[beach]], which was near several [[plant]]-covered rocky outcroppings. ==History== [[File:KierDomadi-LeiaManga.png|thumb|right|200px|Kier Domadi (pictured) suggested to Leia Organa that they visit the Glarus Lagoons.]] By the [[time]] of the [[Imperial Era]], the Glarus Lagoons had become known for their spectacular scenery, romantic atmosphere, and sunshine. In [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' to [[3 BBY]]. the [[Apprentice Legislator]] [[Kier Domadi]] suggested visiting the Glarus Lagoons to his peer, the [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. As Organa considered the proposition, she noticed Domadi's nervous demeanor after asking her. When the [[Gender|princess]] agreed that she would enjoy a trip to the lagoons with him, Domadi smiled. In [[1 BBY]], Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan|annihilated]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]].{{Film|IV}} An illustration of the Glarus Lagoons was included on a [[map]] of Alderaan made by the [[artist]] [[Gammit Chond]], which was included in an updated version of the ''[[Galactic Atlas]]'' [[book]] published by the [[Graf Archive]] at some point no earlier than [[35 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' ==Behind the scenes== The Glarus Lagoons were first mentioned in ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'', a [[2017]] young-adult novel written by [[Claudia Gray]]. The location was identified as the Glarus lagoon in "[[Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region]]," a booklet from [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] that was published on [[June 8]], [[2022]].{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}} They were first pictured in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'', written by [[Emil Fortune]] and [[Paddy Kempshall]] and illustrated by [[Tim McDonagh]]. The Glarus Lagoons partially share their name with both the [[Glarus Valley]] and the [[Glarus Bridges]], two locations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that were introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.{{TORcite|type=location|Glarus Valley|Alderaan}}{{TORcite|type=location|Glarus Bridges|Alderaan}} ==Appearances== *''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' {{Ab|Leia, Princess of Alderaan (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} {{1stID|Glarus lagoon}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Lagons de Glarus }} [[Category:Alderaan locations]]
